name: Animated Wallpaper
author: duarte-gui (fork of jacobobb/omarchy-animated-wallpaper)
description: Play a folder of videos as the desktop wallpaper with mpvpaper, controlled from the Omarchy 4 bar.

barWidget.description: Turns a folder of videos into a looping desktop wallpaper, listed in Omarchy's own background switcher. Left click turns it on or off, right click picks the folder, middle click switches to the next video.

schema.label: Video folder
schema.description: Folder of videos for the wallpaper. Right-clicking the bar button opens a folder picker that fills this in. Supports mp4, webm, mkv, mov, avi, gif and the other common video formats; subfolders are not included.

schema.label: Wallpaper on
schema.description: Whether the animated wallpaper is playing. Left-clicking the bar button flips this, and it is remembered, so the video comes back on its own after you log in again.

schema.label: Playback order
schema.description: Order the middle click walks through the folder: sequential is name order, shuffle mixes it up every time the wallpaper starts.

schema.label: Switch videos
schema.description: manual loops the current video forever and only switches when you middle-click the bar button. end moves on to the next video whenever one finishes.

schema.label: Pause when covered
schema.description: Pause the video while windows cover the whole desktop, so it costs no GPU time when you cannot see it.

schema.label: Extra mpv options
schema.description: Space-separated mpv options added to the defaults, for example panscan=1.0 to fill the screen without black bars, or speed=0.5.

schema.label: Current video
schema.description: The video the wallpaper starts on. The middle click updates it, so the wallpaper comes back to the same video after you log in. Empty means the first video of the folder.

schema.label: Show videos in the background switcher
schema.description: Put a poster for each video (a frame with a play badge) in ~/.config/omarchy/backgrounds/<theme>/, so the videos show up in Omarchy's background switcher next to your images. Picking a poster plays that video; picking an image turns the video off. Turning this off removes the posters.

schema.label: Still background
schema.description: The image the desktop goes back to when the video is turned off from the bar. It is filled in with the background you had when the video started, or the last image you picked in the switcher. Empty means the theme's first background.
